tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (18.3:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: vinyl-black
tokens.usage: Foundation: Record grooves, studio darkness, timeless. Used as text on `.user-avatar`, `.section-action:hover`, `.social-link:hover`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: deep-charcoal
tokens.usage: Depth: Vinyl texture, studio atmosphere.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Excellence: Grammy awards, platinum records, prestige. Used as text on `.logo`, `.nav-link:hover`, `.nav-link.active`. 9.4:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: bronze
tokens.usage: Heritage: Music history, legacy artists, tradition.

tokens.name: warm-white
tokens.usage: Purity: Analog warmth, vintage paper, classic labels. Used as text on `body`, `.nav-link`, `.stat-change`. 18.3:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Softness: Album liner notes, artist statements. Used as text on `.page-subtitle`, `.stat-label`, `.release-meta`. 17.6:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: gold-glow
tokens.usage: Excellence: Grammy awards, platinum records, prestige. Used as shadow/glow on `.user-profile:hover`, `.stat-card:hover`, `.section-action:hover`.

tokens.name: gold-glow-strong
tokens.usage: Excellence: Grammy awards, platinum records, prestige. Used as shadow/glow on `.release-card:hover`.

tokens.name: chart-trend-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.chart-trend.down`, `.category-tag`; border on `.category-tag`; text on `.category-tag`. 19.8:1 on `page-bg`.
